# SheetJS Community Edition

`xlsx-0.20.3.tgz` is the unmodified official SheetJS npm package from:
https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz

SHA-256: `8dc73fc3b00203e72d176e85b50938627c7b086e607c682e8d3c22c02bb99fe8`

Version 0.20.3. License: Apache-2.0 (included in the archive).

The dependency uses this local archive so corporate installations do not need
to contact the SheetJS CDN or disable TLS verification. Do not replace it with
the older npm-registry 0.18.5 release. To update, download a reviewed official
release, verify its hash, update this document and run the import/build checks.
